questions.name: Systolic 140 or above - record the context
questions.text: The reading is high. Record what the client was doing and where she was immediately before and during the measurement - these change how the reading is interpreted.
questions.detail: WHO DAK decision support SMBP.B4.DT.01

questions.name: Systolic 160 or above - go to a facility right away
questions.text: Blood pressure is very high. The client needs to go to a health facility right now to protect herself and her baby.
questions.detail: WHO DAK decision support SMBP.B7.DT.01
